description:
## 1.40.4

### ✨ Improvements

* **YouTube - Voice-Over Translation:** Yandex audio stream now reconnects automatically (bounded retries) when it dies mid-video or fails to prepare.
* **YouTube - Voice-Over Translation:** Yandex translation is silently re-requested during playback when the audio failed to attach, instead of playing untranslated.
* **YouTube - Voice-Over Translation:** Network requests now have timeouts and retries, handling the backend requesting source audio (AUDIO_REQUESTED) with the fail-audio-js fallback.
